scope: Independent audit, read-only. Fully covered: all 21 findings in 10.1 (V-1 to V-21), all 11 workflows (7.1 to 7.11), all 17 questions in 14 (Q-1 to Q-17), and both finding candidates (1a9e722a and 4f05c1b3, both cited in V-18). Sampled by risk (counts, enumerations, auth statements, status progressions): section 3 (3.1 to 3.3); section 4 rows F-1, F-4, F-8, F-9, F-11, F-12, F-13, F-18, F-19, F-21, F-22, F-26, F-27, F-28, F-29 (15 of 29); 5.1 to 5.3; section 6 rows UI-4, UI-8, UI-14, UI-23, UI-25, UI-29 (6 of 40); section 8 (C-2, 8.2, X-5, X-6, entity tables for CatalogItem, Order, PaymentMethod, ApplicationUser and WebhookSubscription, 8.5 C-2); 5 of 22 rows in section 9; section 10.2 (TLS, MFA, rate limiting, lockout); section 11 (ownership, 3 test and process rows, maintenance bullet); section 15 (R-1, R-6, coverage paragraph); section 16 (16.1, 16.2, 16.3, 16.5 build, deploy and rollback, one 16.6 effect row, 16.7). Not audited: generated blocks (2.1 coverage, 4 entry points, 16.6 key table, 16.7 jobs; only the Check covers them), 4.1 file counts, section 13 glossary, section 12 diagrams beyond 3.2, MAUI XAML layout detail, remaining UI, workflow-adjacent test rows, and the other sections 9 and 16.4 rows. Absence and count claims were verified by repository text searches (raw SQL, roles and policies, rate limiting, TwoFactor, LoadingPage, AllowedHosts, token lifetime settings, HSTS). src/Identity.API/tempkey.jwk was not opened (git metadata and size only). No secret values are copied into this register.

claim: Card number, holder, expiry and security number are held in the Identity profile and issued as claims. claim: The order API returns 200 when the command fails or throws, the storefront ignores the response and clears the basket, and a retry with the same request id is treated as a duplicate success

limitation: Fixed card values deliberately not copied

claim: Webhooks.API sends an OPTIONS request to a caller-chosen URL. CORRECTION: the statement that saving requires the target to echo the token header holds only for a non-empty token; with an empty token the expected value is null and any 2xx response without the header passes, and the API does not require a token
limitation: Same-origin check and well-formedness are as stated. The "limits exfiltration to cooperating hosts" sentence should be conditioned on a token being supplied

claim: The webhook token is logged by Webhooks.API (grant test) and by the sample receiver; a default token is committed (value omitted)

claim: Order commands are logged with {@Command} placeholders. limitation: Record ToString output follows from C# record semantics; no running log was inspected. V-15 should be re-pointed at OrdersApi.cs:134 (and Q-11 closed)
